name: tachibot-mcp
description: Multi-model AI orchestration platform with 67 tools across Perplexity, Grok, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, StepFun, ERNIE, and local models

TACHIBOT_PROFILE.title: Tool Profile
TACHIBOT_PROFILE.description: Select tool profile: minimal (14), research_power (38), code_focus (43), balanced (56, default), heavy_coding (59), or full (67 — every tool)

PERPLEXITY_API_KEY.title: Perplexity API Key
PERPLEXITY_API_KEY.description: For web search, research, and reasoning (Get from perplexity.ai)

GROK_API_KEY.title: Grok API Key
GROK_API_KEY.description: For code analysis, debugging, and architecture (Get from x.ai)

OPENAI_API_KEY.title: OpenAI API Key
OPENAI_API_KEY.description: For OpenAI reasoning, search, code review, and explain tools (Get from platform.openai.com)

GOOGLE_API_KEY.title: Google Gemini API Key
GOOGLE_API_KEY.description: For Gemini analysis plus the multi-model jury, diff_review and plan_critique judges (Get from aistudio.google.com)

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.title: OpenRouter API Key
OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Powers the DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, MiniMax, StepFun and ERNIE tools — roughly 20 tools will not register without it (Get from openrouter.ai)

TACHI_ENABLE_CACHE.title: Enable Result Caching
TACHI_ENABLE_CACHE.description: Cache API responses to reduce costs
